environment.virtualizer: same locally patched QEMU 11.1.3 WHPX build as v8; isolated socket Ethernet

method.cpu_sampling: nominal 250 ms; only complete marked intervals; sliding four-sample windows sum ticks
method.cpu_definition: user+nice+system+irq+softirq divided by first eight /proc/stat counters; idle/iowait/steal remain in denominator
method.tcp_clients: two independent AWG clients, each 50 Mbit/s; pilots use one at 100 Mbit/s

patterns.roam: both upload while client1 outer IP and port change and return

method.noise_scope: one random reused payload per trial; invalid UDP, not valid-MAC1 or captured-header attacks
method.rate_gate: sender mean within 1%, entry loss at most 1%, zero switch drops; all offered packets counted independently
method.measurement_window: TCP warmup/run, two-second tail and late sender completion; noise begins about one second before first mark
method.overhead: resident process/CPU collector and fixed job launcher included in whole-VM CPU; no fresh SSH/sudo inside windows
method.policy: ordinary grouped filter, aggregate 50k/5000 and tuple 35k/3500 guard; no IFB or trusted-IP cache
method.rebind_scope: public IP and UDP port changed together by a preinstalled lab NAT rule and runtime listen-port command; same client keys and profile files
method.first_probe_delay: time to first reply from a newly launched ping after local rebind command; includes RPC and process launch; not a continuous-probe outage duration
method.host_cpu_reference: one Windows logical CPU per process, host has 32 logical CPUs; VM threshold does not constrain host helper
method.public_data: checked summaries and arrival bins; complete CPU, process, job and burst traces stay local

acquisition_failures: Two v1 attempts overlapped after controller error: final main/mixed and first DNAT reference; counters/job bind rejected them; excluded and rerun under new IDs.
An immediate reference retry reused an existing resident trace name and was refused before workload; unique replacement IDs used.
A single-controller file lock was added and verified against concurrent ownership.
